questions.text: If you write a gate length below 1000, does GATE_ACTUAL read 1000 (the gate that actually ran) or the value you wrote? Does a GATE_LEN readback show the value you wrote or 1000?
questions.answer: GATE_LEN reads back 1,000, the clamped value, not the value written. The gate that runs is the stored 1,000 cycles, and GATE_ACTUAL reports the reference cycles in the last completed gate, so it reads 1,000.
questions.evidence: A write of GATE_LEN below 1,000 is stored as 1,000 (clamped); reading GATE_LEN back returns the clamped value.

questions.text: What are the top module name and the file name of the design? The interface lists only the board ports (refclk_p/n, clk25_c3, led, sfp_tx_disable), with no port for the register bus.
questions.topic: Names, files and the build target
questions.answer: The top-level module is `p1_clkmeter_top` in `rtl/p1_clkmeter_top.sv`. The register-port core is a separate module, `p1_clkmeter_core` in `rtl/p1_clkmeter_core.sv`. The spec does not say how the register bus is exposed at the top level, only that the bench drives the core.
questions.evidence: - Names and files: the top-level module is named `p1_clkmeter_top` in `rtl/p1_clkmeter_top.sv`; the register-port core (the logic behind the `h_*` port, with no vendor primitive) is a separate module named `p1_clkmeter_core` in `rtl/p1_clkmeter_core.sv`, with ports `clk`, `rst` (active high), `h_we`, `h_re`, `h_addr[11:0]`, `h_wdata[31:0]`, `h_rdata[31:0]` and the design's own signals. Files are SystemVerilog (`.sv`). The bench drives the core.

questions.text: How many ref_clk cycles does the gate last? (Scenario: GATE_LEN is written with 1000, then a measurement runs to completion.) Two careful readers of the requirements disagree about this; what is the intended behaviour?
questions.answer: The gate lasts exactly GATE_LEN reference-clock cycles, so exactly 1000 cycles for GATE_LEN = 1000. GATE_ACTUAL reads 1000 after the measurement completes.
questions.evidence: - When it is done I read how many C3 edges were counted, and how many reference cycles the gate actually lasted (it must equal the gate length I asked for).

questions.text: What do led[1:0] read as (decimal 0-3) right after reset while LED_EN is 0? (Scenario: LED_EN is set to 1 and led[0] has toggled to 1; then rst is asserted and released.) Two careful readers of the requirements disagree about this; what is the intended behaviour?
questions.evidence: LED_EN is 0 after reset, both LEDs are off.

questions.text: What value does GATE_ACTUAL read after completion: the programmed 999, or the clamped 1000? (Scenario: GATE_LEN is written with 999, then START is written and the measurement completes.) The requirements do not say; what should happen?
questions.answer: GATE_ACTUAL reads 1000. A write of 999 is stored as the clamped value 1000, so the gate lasts 1000 reference cycles, and GATE_ACTUAL reports the reference cycles in the last completed gate.
questions.evidence: A write of GATE_LEN below 1,000 is stored as 1,000 (clamped); reading GATE_LEN back returns the clamped value.

questions.text: Is a new measurement started by that second START write? (Scenario: A measurement is in progress (BUSY=1, DONE=0 from a previous START). Software writes CTRL.START again, and on the very same clock the measurement completes and BUSY would fall.) The requirements do not say; what should happen?

After reset release, what are BUSY, SCRATCH and GATE_LEN? Choose the outcome. (Scenario: Mid-measurement (BUSY=1, 50 million cycles into a 156250000-cycle gate), rst is asserted for a few ref_clk cycles, with SCRATCH=0x1234 and LED_EN=1 beforehand.) The requirements do not say; what should happen?
questions.answer: After reset release BUSY=0 (the measurement in progress is abandoned), SCRATCH=0 (the earlier 0x1234 is lost), and GATE_LEN=156,250,000 (the default). LED_EN also returns to 0, so both LEDs are off.
questions.evidence: - Reset: every register resets to 0 except GATE_LEN (156,250,000) and ID. STATUS.BUSY and STATUS.DONE are 0 after reset. COUNT, GATE_ACTUAL and MEAS_DONE are 0 after reset. LED_EN is 0 after reset, both LEDs are off.

questions.text: Does ID still read 0x20910001? (Scenario: A write of 0x1 to ID at 0x000 (read-only register), then a read of 0x000.) The requirements do not say; what should happen?
questions.answer: Yes. The write to the read-only ID register is ignored, so a read of 0x000 still returns 0x20910001.
questions.evidence: Writes to read-only registers are ignored.

questions.text: Does the read return 0x22 (new value) rather than 0x11? (Scenario: SCRATCH holds 0x11. On clock N h_we is asserted writing 0x22 to SCRATCH, and on clock N h_re is asserted reading SCRATCH.) The requirements do not say; what should happen?

What does GATE_ACTUAL read after completion (decimal)? (Scenario: GATE_LEN is 5000 and a measurement is running; software changes GATE_LEN to 2000 mid-gate, and the measurement completes.) The requirements do not say; what should happen?
questions.answer: 5000. The mid-gate write of 2000 is ignored because the measurement is BUSY, so the gate stays at 5000 reference cycles and GATE_ACTUAL reads 5000.
questions.evidence: A write of GATE_LEN while BUSY is ignored.
